language.script: Greek alphabet — a distinct 24-letter script, neither Latin nor Cyrillic; road signs typically pair the Greek place name with a Latin-transliterated version below

terrainDescription.zh: 地形以山地為主（約八成國土多山），愛琴海與愛奧尼亞海沿岸有大量島嶼與曲折海岸線，屬地中海型氣候
terrainDescription.en: Predominantly mountainous (roughly 80% of the terrain), with a Mediterranean climate and a highly indented coastline dotted with islands across the Aegean and Ionian Seas

plate.color: white background, black text; blue EU stripe with gold stars + "GR" code on the left (since 2004)

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Wedge-shaped bollards with near-square reflectors — red on the front face, white on the back

utilityPole.transformerMount: Small lamps attached to the side of the pole with a round shade above the bulb — a style also shared with North Macedonia and Serbia; pole material commonly concrete but not strongly confirmed for this specific detail

historicalContext.zh: 希臘語使用專屬的希臘字母（24個字母），既非拉丁字母也非西里爾字母，是全歐洲辨識度最高的文字系統之一；路牌通常以希臘文為主、下方輔以拉丁字母轉寫的地名。
historicalContext.en: Greek uses its own 24-letter alphabet — neither Latin nor Cyrillic — making it one of the single clearest script-based identifiers in all of Europe; road signs typically show the Greek place name with a Latin-transliterated version below.
